actions.name: ActionTriggerDialog8
actions.subtitle: Whaddya want with diamonds, Ock?  Your kind of ugly goes deeper than jewelry can fix.

actions.name: ActionTriggerDialog2
actions.subtitle: Peter, thank you for taking time out of your school day to come to the bank with me.

actions.name: ActionTriggerDialog3
actions.subtitle: It's my pleasure, Aunt May. I'll just make some time to study later.

actions.name: ActionTriggerDialog4
actions.subtitle: I hope you don't spend too much time cutting classes.

actions.name: ActionTriggerDialog5
actions.subtitle: No way. Of course not.  I'm a model student.

actions.name: ActionTriggerDialog6
actions.subtitle: Sorry, I don't feel well.  Will you excuse me?

actions.name: ActionTriggerDialog7
actions.subtitle: Of course, honey. I'll be right here.

actions.name: ActionTriggerDialog1
actions.subtitle: First things first! I've got to find Aunt May!

actions.name: ACTION_ObjectiveAdd1
actions.Message: Find and Rescue the Entrance Security Guard.

actions.name: ACTION_ObjectiveAdd6
actions.Message: Find and Rescue the Basement Security Guard.

actions.name: ACTION_Say6
actions.subtitle: Apparently police work in this city is not what it once was.

actions.name: ACTION_Say7
actions.subtitle: I suppose I shouldn't be rude though. Thank you for your help, Spider-Man.

actions.name: ACTION_Say8
actions.subtitle: Look for one of our security guards, Spider-Man. They have keys that will help you get down to the vault.

actions.name: ACTION_Say2
actions.subtitle: Thanks, I was getting hot in there. Doc Ock is in the other vault, the Precious Metals vault. This keycode will let you in.

actions.name: ACTION_ObjectiveAdd15
actions.Message: Find and Rescue the Basement Security Guard.

actions.name: ACTION_ObjectiveAdd8
actions.Message: Find and Rescue the Vault Security Guard.

actions.name: ACTION_Say21
actions.subtitle: Thanks, Spider-Man! Doc Ock is in the Precious Metals vault. I don't have the code, but my partner does. He's locked in the cash vault. This code will get you in there.

actions.name: ACTION_ObjectiveAdd3
actions.Message: Stop Doc Ock From Stealing The Diamonds.

actions.name: ACTION_Say5
actions.subtitle: These doors are shut tight. Need to get into the security room to open them.

actions.name: ACTION_Say4
actions.subtitle: This door won't open.  Need to find a security guard who'll give me the keycode.

actions.name: ACTION_Say10
actions.subtitle: Let's get out of here!

actions.name: ACTION_Say22
actions.subtitle: Come on, lady, you're riding with us!

actions.name: ACTION_Say23
actions.subtitle: Help, Spider-Man!

actions.name: ACTION_Say24
actions.subtitle: I'll have to catch up with Ock later.  Can't let them take Aunt May!

actions.name: ACTION_Say9
actions.subtitle: Thanks, Spider-Man!

actions.name: ACTION_Say25
actions.subtitle: This door won't open.  Need to find a security guard who'll give me the keycode.

actions.name: ACTION_Say1
actions.subtitle: Bet that security guard needs my help as much as I need his.

actions.name: ACTION_Say20
actions.subtitle: Looks like Ock broke this door.  It won't budge.

actions.name: ACTION_Say16
actions.subtitle: It's great to see you, Spider-Man!

actions.name: ACTION_Say17
actions.subtitle: Is there a shortcut to the basement?

actions.name: ACTION_Say18
actions.subtitle: Look for the elevator shaft on the first floor, then take it to the basement.

actions.name: ACTION_Say19
actions.subtitle: You'll need this keycode to get into the elevator.

actions.name: ACTION_ObjectiveAdd14
actions.Message: Open Up the Second Floor Fire Doors.

actions.name: ACTION_ObjectiveAdd4
actions.Message: Find and Rescue the Security Guard on the Second Floor.

actions.name: ACTION_ObjectiveAdd10
actions.Message: Get to the Preciuos Metals Vault

actions.name: ACTION_Say11
actions.subtitle: Thanks, Spider-Man!

actions.name: ACTION_Say12
actions.subtitle: Doc Ock's on his way to the basement, but he broke the door when he forced it open.

actions.name: ACTION_Say13
actions.subtitle: There's another way to the basement, but it won't be easy.  Look for the security guard stuck on the second floor behind the security doors.  He'll help you from there.

actions.name: ACTION_Say14
actions.subtitle: Take this keycard and use it to access our security room.  From there, you can open the second floor doors.

actions.name: ACTION_Say15
actions.subtitle: Security guard stuck on the second floor.  Got it.

actions.name: ACTION_Say3
actions.subtitle: They couldn't have taken her far... I'll check behind those teller windows.
